text:
maria: Quick handoff — I'm stepping out in ~20m :wave: Leaving coverage to @liam for the next 8h. Two things to watch (non-incident)

maria: 1) Encoder pool CPU jitter — intermittent spikes on eu-encoders (pods bounce between 65-95% for a few minutes). No impact to SLOs yet but alerts are noisy.

maria: 2) Prefix cache signal fuzz — some cache-hit-rate flicker on long-tail requests, mainly affects rerank workloads. Seen small latency blips in dashboards.

maria: Known context: we rolled a servlet JVM GC tweak on Monday, and priya reverted the aggressive probe for the encoder autoscaler last night which helped but didn't fully silence the spike. No customer-facing incidents.

liam: Thanks — taking it. I'll keep an eye on encoder CPU and autoscaler thrash. If I see sustained >90% for 5m I'll trigger a temporary scale-up and annotate the incident board.

priya: FYI I adjusted alert noise yesterday: reduced noisy alert for encoder-cpu-high from 3m->8m, but the dashboard still shows short bursts. If you want quieter thresholds I can bump to 10m for the weekend.

sam: @maria quick Q — where's the runbook for encoder pool scaling?

maria: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/encoder-pool — contains checklist, escalation steps, and the small helper script to drain a node.

priya: Also useful: quick repro logs filter — run: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=encoder-pool --tail=200 | grep "CPU usage"```

oncall-bot: ALERT (automated): encoder-pool-cpu-high fired 2147499800 — recovered. (notice: short spike, threshold 70% 3m)

liam: I'll watch the alert frequency. If oncall-bot keeps firing, I'll post a brief note in #incidents with timestamps and attach pprof snapshots.

maria: Hand-off checklist for @liam: monitor alerts, keep autoscaler at default unless sustained >5m, annotate any scale actions in the rotation doc, and ping priya for tuning. I left a short note in the deck under "encoder follow-ups".

liam: Got it. I'll also run a quick smoke after the next deploy window around 03:00 UTC.

priya: If you need to quiet things urgently, run `kubectl annotate deployment encoder-pool maintenance=true --overwrite` then scale replicas=+2, annotate and revert after 30min. Don't forget to remove the maintenance annotation.

sam: I'll spare a quick look at the prefix-cache dashboards and post numbers if I see correlation to specific routes.

maria: Thanks team — leaving contact for escalation: pager for eng-oncall in rotation, and Priya for encoding infra. Back tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
